solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Believe Canute originally, king turning back the waves

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of the name Canute

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for rex, king

indicators.note: turning back says the word for the waves is read from right to left

parts.note: the tide is the movement of the waves

explanation.surface: King Canute famously failed to make the sea retreat; here someone is asked to believe the legend.
explanation.definitionFit: To give credit to a story is to accept it as true, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Reportedly, found a way to get to firm

indicators.note: Reportedly says we want a word that sounds the same as the phrase that follows when spoken

parts.note: routed means planned a route, found a way to go

explanation.surface: Someone finds a way to reach a company, as reports have it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'firm' looks like a business but is the adjective meaning fixed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something rooted is fixed in place and cannot be moved, hence firm.

clue.text: Due to play with dog, lob projectile

indicators.note: play suggests the letters frolic and rearrange themselves

explanation.surface: A pet owner is expected to play fetch with the dog, lobbing a ball.
explanation.walkthrough: DUE, DOG and LOB are shuffled together.
explanation.definitionFit: The doodlebug was the nickname for the German V-1 flying bomb of World War II, a missile.

clue.text: Person up for trial

parts.note: reads like a defendant awaiting trial, but describes someone up in the air testing a new aircraft

explanation.surface: An accused person is about to be tried in court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' is literally aloft and 'trial' is a test flight.
explanation.definitionFit: A test pilot flies new aircraft on trial flights, so is literally up in the air for a trial.

clue.text: Partially restore a dormitory for foreign competitor

indicators.note: Partially says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An instruction to partly refurbish a dormitory, perhaps for a visiting athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: A toreador is a Spanish bullfighter, someone who competes in a contest abroad.

clue.text: Retaining energy, bats to land with claws

indicators.note: Retaining says the shuffled letters hold another inside them
bats, meaning crazy, signals the letters are jumbled

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Bats keep enough energy in reserve to land, gripping with their claws.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bats' makes TALOND, which 'Retaining' wraps round E; the bats are not animals here.
explanation.definitionFit: Talons are the hooked claws of a bird of prey, so taloned means having claws.

clue.text: Measure Aga, perhaps

definitions.meaning: a measuring stick marked in inches or centimetres
an Aga (or agha) is a title for a commander or chief in the Ottoman Empire, one who governs

explanation.surface: Someone checking the size of their Aga cooker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Aga' suggests the British range cooker, but here it is the Ottoman title.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a straightedge for measuring length; the other is a sovereign or governor, of which an Aga is an example.

clue.text: A parrot circles head of lone wolf

indicators.note: circles says the bird's name goes round the following letter

parts.note: the kea is a New Zealand parrot

indicators.note: head of picks the opening letter of the word lone

explanation.surface: A parrot flies around the leader of a solitary wolf.
explanation.definitionFit: Akela is the leader of the wolf pack in Kipling's The Jungle Book, a grey wolf.

clue.text: Manage to support upended drunk after initially obtaining medical device

indicators.note: after places the drunk's letters following that opening letter
in a down clue, to support means to sit underneath the preceding letters
initially takes the first letter of the word obtaining
upended in a down clue turns the word for drunk upside down

parts.note: a sot is a habitual drunkard
to cope is to manage

explanation.surface: A doctor deals with a drunk who has fallen over and needs an instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: An otoscope is the instrument a doctor uses to look inside the ear.

clue.text: Giant's defeat when deluged by rocks

definitions.note: read as Giant is: the 's stands for 'is' and is folded into the definition

indicators.note: deluged by says the loss is swamped, sitting inside the rocks

parts.note: coal is lumps of rock, burned as fuel
a defeat is a loss

explanation.surface: A giant suffers defeat when buried under falling rocks.
explanation.walkthrough: Giant's is read as 'Giant is', the adjective meaning huge.
explanation.definitionFit: Giant as an adjective means enormous, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Hide fabrication beside base

parts.note: a lie is a fabrication
base in the sense of mean, contemptible, is low

explanation.surface: Concealing a falsehood next to a military base.
explanation.definitionFit: To lie low is an idiom for keeping out of sight, hiding.

clue.text: Become emotional after leader goes missing from balloon

indicators.note: says the first letter is lost from the word for balloon

parts.note: to balloon is to swell up

explanation.surface: Someone gets tearful when the lead balloon fails to rise.
explanation.walkthrough: SWELL UP loses its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Tears well up when someone is moved, an idiom for becoming emotional.

clue.text: Rampant Roman regularly lucky — the usual state of affairs in the US

definitions.text: the usual state of affairs in the US

indicators.note: rampant, running wild, signals the letters of Roman are rearranged
regularly takes every other letter of lucky

explanation.surface: A rampaging Roman soldier is lucky to survive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rampant' turns ROMAN into NORMA; 'regularly' gives LCY.
explanation.definitionFit: Normalcy is the American word for normality, the ordinary condition of things.

clue.text: They grab sheets and pills, suffering with cold bug

indicators.note: suffering suggests the letters are in a bad state, jumbled

explanation.surface: A sick patient grabs sheets and pills while suffering with a cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Bulldog clips are spring clips that grip sheets of paper together.

clue.text: Magnificent region, sad to undergo redevelopment

indicators.note: redevelopment rebuilds something, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rundown region badly in need of regeneration.
explanation.definitionFit: Grandiose means imposing and impressive in scale, a synonym for magnificent.

clue.text: Sluggish mobile — charge it after end of call

indicators.note: after puts the shuffled letters following that letter
end of picks the final letter of call
mobile, able to move, signals the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sluggish mobile phone needs charging once the call is over.
explanation.definitionFit: Lethargic means drowsy and lacking energy, a synonym for sluggish.

clue.text: Legendary female hybrid animal in a novel (unfinished)

indicators.note: in says the hybrid's name sits inside the other letters
unfinished drops the last letter of the word for novel

parts.note: novel means new
a tigon is the cross between a tiger and a lioness

explanation.surface: A mythical creature appears in an incomplete novel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfinished' cuts NEW to NE; TIGON goes into A NE.
explanation.definitionFit: Antigone is the daughter of Oedipus in Greek legend, heroine of Sophocles' tragedy.

clue.text: King and Queen after dark angrily yell for absent horseman

indicators.note: after puts the queen's letters following the word for dark

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
night is the dark
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the standard abbreviation for the Queen
to rant is to shout angrily

explanation.surface: Royals rage at night because a rider has gone missing.
explanation.definitionFit: A medieval knight errant roamed far from home on horseback seeking adventure, hence an absent horseman.

clue.text: No official expected to be disheartened

parts.note: ref, short for referee, is a match official

indicators.note: disheartened removes the heart, the middle letter, of the word

parts.note: usual means expected, as normal

explanation.surface: A referee is unexpectedly downcast at not being picked.
explanation.definitionFit: A no is a rejection or denial, as is a refusal.

clue.text: What might help to get you in important set of papers

definitions.text: What might help to get you in

parts.note: key means crucial, important
a pad is a block of writing paper

explanation.surface: An important set of documents might win you admission.
explanation.definitionFit: A keypad is a set of buttons for entering a code to open a door or lock.

clue.text: Berkshire town with university for old fellow to do water sport

indicators.note: for says one letter stands in place of another

parts.note: Windsor, home of the royal castle, is a town in the English county of Berkshire

explanation.surface: A Windsor academic swaps old ways for a new pastime on the water.
explanation.walkthrough: In WINDSOR the O is replaced by U.
explanation.definitionFit: To windsurf is to ride a board with a sail across the water, a water sport.

clue.text: Finishes eating second portions

indicators.note: eating says the word for finishes swallows the letter

parts.note: does, as in does for or does in, means finishes off

explanation.surface: Someone finishes their meal and goes back for second helpings.
explanation.definitionFit: Doses are measured amounts, such as portions of medicine.

clue.text: Detach page with superior French article at home

indicators.note: superior in a down clue places the article above the page letter

parts.note: un is the French for a, the indefinite article
in means at home

explanation.surface: A haughty French article detaches a page while at home.
explanation.definitionFit: To unpin is to remove the pins holding something, so to detach it.

clue.text: Returned premium boxlike container

indicators.note: Returned says the word for premium comes back the other way

parts.note: a premium is a bonus or reward

explanation.surface: A bonus is sent back in a box.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawer is a sliding box in a piece of furniture.

clue.text: Turn one's back on son and quietly chat

indicators.note: on says the next piece is attached after the son's letter

parts.note: a go is a turn

indicators.note: back says the letters for one's are read in reverse

parts.note: one's means one is, I plus S
P, piano, is the musical instruction to play quietly

explanation.surface: A parent turns away from a son to have a quiet talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Gossip is idle talk about others, and to gossip is to chat.

clue.text: Prevent spring recoiling after good temporary measures

indicators.note: after places the reversed spring following the letter for good

parts.note: to stop is to prevent

indicators.note: recoiling says the word for spring springs back, read backwards

parts.note: a spa is a mineral spring

explanation.surface: Stopping a coiled spring from recoiling is only a temporary fix.
explanation.definitionFit: A stopgap is a makeshift that fills a need until something better comes.

clue.text: A long time to house relative in place that's private

indicators.note: in says the combined letters sit inside the abbreviation for place
to house says the long time contains the relative

parts.note: an era is a long period of time
a son is a relative

explanation.surface: A relative has long been living in a secluded home.
explanation.definitionFit: Something personal is private, concerning one individual alone.

clue.text: Company intervening in final close of sale scramble

indicators.note: intervening in says the company sits within the word for final

parts.note: the end is the final part

indicators.note: close of picks the last letter of sale

explanation.surface: A firm steps in at the last moment to ruin a sale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scramble' looks like the anagram signal but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To scramble a message is to put it into code so outsiders cannot read it.
